method: Visual inspection of downloaded candidate contact sheet; metadata checked against Commons response. No claim that photographs were taken in Kruger.

aardvark.features: Long tubular snout, large upright ears, arched back and thick tapering tail.

aardwolf.features: Small hyena-like animal with vertical dark stripes, erect mane and large pointed ears.

banded-mongoose.features: Small mongoose with repeated dark transverse bands across its back.

black-backed-jackal.features: Pointed muzzle and ears, reddish sides and contrasting dark grizzled saddle.

blue-wildebeest.features: Heavy-shouldered dark antelope, broad muzzle, curved horns and long black tail; adult with calf.

caracal.features: Plain reddish coat, black-backed ears with long black tufts, dark facial markings.

hippopotamus.features: Large barrel-shaped grey body, short legs, broad muzzle and high-set eyes and ears.

serval.features: Very long legs, small head, large ears and golden coat with black spots and neck stripes.

african-civet.features: Dark face mask, pale neck bands, spotted and barred body, dorsal mane and ringed tail.

bat-eared-fox.features: Very large rounded ears, dark facial mask and legs, grey-brown coat and bushy dark-tipped tail.

brown-hyena.features: Long shaggy brown coat, pale neck mantle, sloping back and striped legs.

bushpig.features: Shaggy pig with pale face and dorsal mane, dark legs and elongated snout; lacks the prominent facial warts of warthog.

common-duiker.features: Small grey-brown antelope with arched back, slender legs, pointed ears and dark facial stripe.

eland.features: Large tan antelope, tightly spiralled horns and deep hanging dewlap; common eland form.

quarantined.african-wild-cat: Domestic-cat or hybrid identity cannot be excluded visually from the candidate.
quarantined.african-clawless-otter: Feet and diagnostic details are not sufficiently clear; second candidate is an anatomical bone plate.
quarantined.bushveld-gerbil: Similar gerbils require diagnostic/expert confirmation; not approved from external appearance.
quarantined.cape-hare: Similar Lepus species cannot be confidently distinguished from this view.
quarantined.dwarf-mongoose: Scale and diagnostic separation from similar small mongoose species need further review.
quarantined.grey-rhebok: Only rear view or distant animal; insufficient diagnostic detail.
